claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_list_pick
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing surface only grants named spells by spellId. This item instead lets the user attempt any eligible unknown spell from the Wizard spell list, bounded by spell level and material-cost constraints.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.chosen_spell_casting_time
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activation does not have a fixed action cost. On success it resolves using the selected spell's normal casting time, which the current non-spell activation header cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationResource.spell_slot
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item spends the wielder's spell slot rather than a use-count or charge pool. The current activation-resource surface for non-spell units cannot consume spell slots.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: success_only_cooldown_after_ability_check
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's once-per-rest lockout applies only on the successful branch of the Arcana check. Existing activation resources are consumed at activation time rather than conditionally after one branch resolves.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a successful check, you cast the spell ... and you can't use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead"
